name: bootcamp
short: Dynamically create custom LLM agents with their own system prompt, registered as A2A agents.
description: Lets a bot owner create/remove custom LLM agents at runtime, each with its own system prompt and corridor permission-group gate. Every created agent registers into corridor's shared AgentDirectoryService (making it consultable by pico's dynamic consult_<agent_key> tool, and visible on cctv, exactly like architect/painter), gets whatever MCP tools are currently granted to it via corridor's AgentToolServerRegistry (suggestionbox/telephonepole), and can also be invoked directly with [p]bootcamp ask <agent_key> <prompt>.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends A2A task messages and direct-invoke prompts it receives to corridor's configured LLM endpoint. It does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users.
install_msg: Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. Outside services: each custom agent sends its prompts, A2A task text and tool results to corridor's LLM endpoint, and may call MCP servers granted to it through suggestionbox or telephonepole. Setup: configure [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model, create an agent with [p]bootcamp create (bot owner), then consult it through pico or directly with [p]bootcamp ask <agent_key> <prompt>.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
